title: isodon capillipes
intro: Isodon capillipes, commonly known as Chinese mint or Himalayan mint, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of I. capillipes include its ability to clear heat, relieve fever, and reduce swelling, making it a popular remedy for conditions such as sore throats and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of I. capillipes include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
